newsitem.title: CHINA: New World in US$80 mln hotels sale.
newsitem.headline: New World in US$80 mln hotels sale.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd said it had sold its hotel property interests outside Hong Kong, China and Southeast Asia to a company controlled by New World's managing director and other officials for US$80 million.

New World Development said in a statement on Monday that its 64 percent owned unit New World Hotels (Holdings) Ltd had sold its entire stake in wholly-owned Hotel Property Investments (B.V.I.) Ltd to CTF Holdings Ltd.
CTF Holdings is controlled by New World Development managing director Henry Cheng, New World Infrastructure Ltd vice chairman William Doo Wai Hoi and Cheng Kam Biu.
Hotel Property Investments hold hotel property interests in the Americas, Australia and Europe.
"As a result of the sale, the New World group will cease to have any hotel investments outside Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, China and Southeast Asia," it said.
New World Development said the price had been calculated by reference to the consolidated net tanglible asset value of Hotel Property Investments plus a premium of about US$18.75 million.
